new_intro: Smart Cache, caption editing, Smart Search and about 100 languages. Plus two fixes we made before release.
cache_body: Smart Cache remembers what it has already transcribed. Run a clip again and it comes back at once. Extend it, and only the new part is processed.
cache_status_idle: Press Transcribe to run the whole clip.
cache_status_done_full: Done. The whole clip was transcribed.
cache_status_cached: Back at once. Nothing had to be transcribed.
cache_status_extended: Clip extended. Run it again to see what happens.
cache_status_done_part: Done. Only the new part went through Whisper.
cache_note: An illustration. Real time depends on your Mac, the clip and the model.
edit_title: Fix it before it hits the timeline
edit_body: Correct a name, change start and end times, or remove a line. Your edits are saved on your Mac and come back next time.
search_title: Find any line, in any clip
search_body: Search every caption across all your clips. See the text, the file and the timecode. A click won’t jump to the clip.

lang_body: That is the model’s coverage. We did not test every language, so review your captions. Accuracy depends on the language, recording and speaker.
fix1: Captions no longer pile up on top of each other, and every caption now has a remove button.
fix2: Captions stay in sync when your audio is detached or comes from a separate recorder.
figure_alt: The 1.1.1 caption list: a “Captions” header with “7 segments”, rows of Turkish captions with start and end times and a remove icon, and one caption being edited.
feature4_title: Your edits stay on your Mac.
feature4_body: Smart Cache and your caption edits are stored on your Mac, not uploaded. You can switch the cache off.
card_bottom: Pick up where you left off.
preview_note_html: Update: these features shipped on September 30 as version 1.1.1, together with two extra fixes. This page stays online as we wrote it.
faq_new_a: Smart Cache, caption editing, Smart Search, about 100 languages with Auto Detect, and a layout that fits smaller windows. Read the full story.
faq_why_a: 1.1 was finished, then a last test on real projects found two bugs. We fixed both the same day and renumbered. 1.1.1 is 1.1 plus two fixes. The full story.
faq_lang_a: About 100, plus Auto Detect. That is the speech model’s coverage. We did not test caption quality in each language, so accuracy depends on the language, recording, speaker and model. Please review your captions.
community_body: Our launch video and Shorts are on YouTube, and Reels on Instagram. Follow along for demos, editing tips and updates.
download_meta: v1.1.1 · For Final Cut Pro · Apple silicon · macOS 26.4+
privacy_cache: Smart Cache keeps your transcripts, your caption edits and the search index in a local database on your Mac. The app and its Final Cut Pro extension share this database. It is not uploaded anywhere. You can turn Smart Cache off in the extension.
